title: Classify active production Web-container SMTP transport and AUTH without sending mail
acceptance: diagnostic is owner-only and bound to release issue 3072 and registration matrix 3785
diagnostic executes inside exactly one active production Web container selected by Docker Compose service label
diagnostic consumes the Web container existing PC_SMTP_* environment without printing values
SMTP authority must be mail.hosting.reg.ru port 465 implicit TLS or diagnostic fails closed
diagnostic performs only TLS greeting, EHLO transparent-price.local, AUTH PLAIN, MAIL FROM, RSET and QUIT
diagnostic must never issue RCPT TO or DATA and therefore must not send any message
diagnostic publishes only bounded stage classes and latency buckets; no credential, email address, container id, image name or raw protocol response is published
diagnostic does not execute database commands and does not mutate identity, password, MFA, session, runtime files, containers or deployment
SSH accepts exactly one host key matching the protected SHA-256 fingerprint and keeps StrictHostKeyChecking=yes
exact current main is checked before and after the production read
